runtimeOwner: Gateway session lifecycle + admission registry + existing session mutation journal table

cases.fault: Archive while a session is active or still owns queued/process/subagent state.
cases.expected: cleanupSessionBeforeMutation fences and drains before mutation.

cases.fault: Admission fence/drain/owner cleanup returns an unavailable result.
cases.expected: Return unavailable/retryable and leave transcript, archive index and store row unchanged.
evidence: openclaw_runtime/src/gateway/session-archive-service.test.ts#does not mutate transcript or store when the lifecycle finalizer fails

cases.fault: Process stops after transcript/index preparation or after store commit, before runtime finalization.
cases.expected: Same operationId resumes from intent/store_committed state and returns the saved committed receipt.

cases.fault: The source store row disappears after the archive intent is recorded.
cases.expected: Definitive conflict, definitive failure metadata and cleanup fence release.
evidence: openclaw_runtime/src/gateway/session-archive-service.test.ts#classifies a vanished archive source as a definitive conflict

cases.fault: Restore inserts the new store row but stops before transcript rename and index removal.
cases.expected: Archive index continues filtering the key and the same operationId completes recovery.

cases.fault: An archived transcript is absent during the first restore attempt.
cases.expected: Retryable unknown; row remains fenced and exact operation can recover after the source reappears.

cases.fault: Both live and archived transcripts exist.
cases.expected: Definitive conflict and release of the new-generation fence.
evidence: openclaw_runtime/src/gateway/session-archive-service.test.ts#releases the new-generation fence when both live and archived transcripts exist

cases.fault: A late run event from the archived physical generation reaches the restored logical session.
cases.expected: Fresh physical sessionId; old generation cannot mutate the new row.

cases.fault: A legacy archive entry has a { key } snapshot without a physical sessionId.
cases.expected: The generation is recovered from the archived transcript filename.

cases.fault: A malformed archive index or journal points outside the session store.
cases.expected: Structured definitive refusal before unsafe mutation; the mirror gate can be released.

cases.fault: A different mutation kind is requested while archive is pending.
cases.expected: The persisted Main gate rejects the different kind and permits only original-operation retry.

cases.fault: The archive RPC times out or returns no matching committed receipt.
cases.expected: Main retains the gate and exact operationId; retry succeeds only on a matching receipt.

cases.fault: Runtime returns a correlated definitive refusal.
cases.expected: Main releases the gate; retryable failures remain gated.

cases.fault: Requested legacy session key differs from the runtime canonical key.
cases.expected: Runtime receipt echoes the requested key for Main correlation while retaining canonical identity internally.

cases.fault: Archive index exists before full store/file finalization.
cases.expected: sessions.list excludes the key by archive-index membership.

cases.fault: The archive index is malformed or foreign-versioned.
cases.expected: Read-only listing remains available with an empty archive view; write paths still fail closed.

cases.fault: Shared lifecycle cleanup changes delete/reset/terminal behavior.
cases.expected: Legacy best-effort owner cleanup semantics remain for reset/delete; archive remains strict.

knownLimitations: A2 E2E covers one isolated local workspace; multi-workspace acceptance belongs to F1.
A transcript temporarily missing during restore remains retryable by design; the same operationId and fence must converge before another destructive action can start.
A complete fault injection at every individual filesystem/sqlite syscall boundary is not claimed; accepted cases cover intent, store_committed, committed-response loss and transcript/index windows.
